easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Market Gnome.
When Market Gnome dies, its first ability and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Market Gnome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Market Gnome from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Market Gnome by paying {W}.
Repeat.
